device_admission.base_clause: device D admits base token T iff T.sm_number <= D.sm_number
device_admission.a_clause: device D admits a-token T iff T.sm_number == D.sm_number

ordering: sort by (sm_number ascending, variant: base < a)
coverage_note: closed enumeration; a cuda: capability-set is a single scalar token (§4), so the §6.8-0007 length-digest and §6.8-0013 vector obligations do not apply
versioning: adding or removing a token, altering an admission relation, or changing the encoding layer is a version bump
